headline: Gasoline prices rise again from this afternoon
summary: Domestic retail petroleum prices will rise from 3 p.m. on 20 August under a joint decision of the Industry and Trade and Finance ministries. Diesel prices continue to rise sharply, exceeding 28,500 VND per liter.
why: Retail fuel prices in Vietnam are set administratively and feed into transport costs, inflation and the outlook for consumer spending and logistics firms.
